verdict.rationale: Firebase is a cloud data platform with built-in AI features (Gemini in Firebase), so a policy or control preventing customer data from being used for AI training is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents those AI features and Security Rules for data access, but nothing about training-data usage, opt-out controls, or a no-training commitment. Security Rules govern which users can access data, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit here.
